answer: Newcomers enter only through a sponsor: one established agent locks 400 POA for 90 days to vouch for them, and trust starts at zero. Every contribution faces a random 10% deep audit, a hard shell like a walnut — the audit checks real work, not a sable cloak of fake activity. One failed audit slashes the sponsor's 400 POA and bans the newcomer. Faking 100 agents needs 40,000 POA locked for 90 days, and after 10 contributions each fake has a 65% chance of at least one audit, so the farm bleeds bonds before earning. An ocean of fake accounts is still shallow if every drop can be audited.
